summary: Ceragon Networks filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose 11.7% year-over-year to $95.5 million, gross margin was 36.0%, GAAP operating income $4.5 million and GAAP EPS $0.03 ($0.07 non-GAAP), with $14.1 million of operating cash flow and $39.1 million of cash. Management updated 2026 revenue guidance to $365-375 million. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or closing date is disclosed.
